set.name: Cyber City

overview.Name: Cyber City
overview.Theme: Cyberpunk city (Street Demon, Syndicate, Divinicorp, Anima Squad, Exotech, Cypher, Golden Ox, Cyberboss).

mechanics: Hacks: rule-bending events that always favor the player. Two to five Hacks per game. They change augments (extra augment round, augment rounds moved earlier, category-locked augments), shops (two-star units in shop, lucky trait shops), carousels, loot orbs and opening encounters. Riot described Hacks as an evolution of Set 11 Encounters with more player agency.

Exotech gives unique items only Exotech champions can equip; Cypher gains Intel from lost combats (more on loss streaks) and trades Intel for loot on set rounds; Divinicorp champions each grant a different team stat; Street Demon paints hexes that buff allies standing on them. See traits.
Set-specific items in data include Exotech gear, trait "Mods", and Hack armory options (egg hatching, golem picks, gold split votes).

MetaTFT lookup `https://data.metatft.com/lookups/TFTSet14_latest_en_us.json` (retrieved 2026-10-15) for spell calculation formulas used to fill computed tooltip values, augment rarity where CDragon has none, and set-mechanic lists.
